soundness_flags.label: def:fuzzy-mixtures; thm:fuzzy-nuisance-lower; oeq:arbitrary-density-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed q_omega factorizes as (1+r_A u_omega(x))(1-s_Y v_omega(x))/4, so A and Y are conditionally independent given X under every Q_omega and U=Psi=0; Q_omega cannot belong to the separated alternative class.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:high-smoothness-density-robustness
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The matching root-n lower bound is conditional on existence of the stated nondegenerate QMD constant-contrast path with finite source norm.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The two-sided root-n equality is claimed only under that class-richness premise; the density-robust upper bound remains unconditional on it.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The preprint defines a conditional distributional treatment-effect estimand, derives a doubly robust procedure, and states valid type-I error and fixed-alternative consistency for global conditional-law homogeneity testing.
The article proves a Hölder CATE minimax lower bound using localized fuzzy hypotheses and analyzes a local-polynomial higher-order R-learner attainability construction under additional conditions.
The paper develops empirical-HOIF estimators for a scalar missing-at-random mean and related scalar doubly robust functionals without a smoothness condition on the covariate density.
The paper studies direct two-sample tests, proves spectral regularization can improve the Hellinger separation boundary over MMD, and gives an adaptive test up to a logarithmic factor.
The paper defines CoDiTE through conditional mean embeddings, uses an associated hypothesis test, and studies conditional witness functions and U-statistic regression.
MMDAgg controls level nonasymptotically and attains Sobolev-ball minimax rates up to an iterated-logarithmic term in the direct two-sample setting.
The paper studies minimax conditional-independence testing with continuous conditioning covariates under smooth conditional-law assumptions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the paired fuzzy family with an explicit non-factorizing alternative construction and verify algebraically that each Q_omega has nonzero embedded conditional contrast while the required mixtures remain close; recompute exact-null membership, source membership, and affinity from that replacement.

Before restoring the flagship OEQ, add a finite worked instance calculating P(Y=y_+|A=a,X=x), U(x), and Psi for both sides of the proposed fuzzy pair; require this audit as an invariant of every lower-bound construction.

Strengthen the oracle root-n theorem's lower-bound premise to require a regular nonzero source-class direction (or a constant-contrast path explicitly verified to lie in the source ball), rather than only a_0>0.

recommended_next_step: Pivot to a repaired lower-bound experiment: the current fuzzy construction makes the asserted alternatives exact SCoDiTE-null laws, so the flagship occupancy frontier has no viable converse kernel as written.
